name: Generate ROIs for Visual White Matter Tracking in dMRI Space (Glasser Parcellation) Binned by prf Eccentricity Estimates - Deprecated Surface
summary: This app will generate ROIs that can be used for visual white matter tracking, including optic radiation tracking.
description: This app will generate ROIs that can be used for visual white matter tracking, including optic radiation tracking. This includes visual areas from the Glasser parcellation, the left and right LGNs from a thalamic nuclei segmentation, and exclusion ROIs from freesurfer. The ROIs will be resliced into diffusion space in of this. The Glasser ROIs will be binned by Eccentricity based on pRF mapping

inputs.description: Path to the freesurfer datatype. This NEEDS to have been run through segment thalamic nuclei app, or have the thalamic nuclei generated in the original freesurfer generation, for this to work. This is used to generate the LGN ROIs.
Specify this if you want to use your custom brainmask. If neither dtiinit nor brainmask is specified, this App will create brainmask from your dwi input using FSL bet.
This is the path to the parcellation/volume datatype. This NEEDS to contain the glasser parcellation mapped to the subject. This is used to generate visual rois.

parameters.description:
if ROI inflation into WM for thalamus segmentation is wanted, specify the number of inflated voxels desired

example: 1
